vulnerabilities.description: Agnaistic agnai through 1.0.555 contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability in self-host.docker-compose.yml, which sets a fixed admin password and public JWT secret. Unauthenticated attackers can log in as admin or sign their own JWT with admin: true to impersonate users, reset passwords, and change server configuration.

The return value of that call was discarded and the once guard was latched to true even when the call failed. Traccar through 6.16.0 contains a weak password recovery vulnerability that allows attackers to reuse password reset tokens as session credentials because TokenManager does not bind tokens to a purpose. Attackers holding a leaked reset link can obtain a full session via /api/session or change passwords via /api/password/update, retaining access for seven days even after the victim resets their password.

pH7Builder (pH7 Social Dating CMS) before 18.5.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows API clients to obtain sensitive member data because UserController::users() and user() return unfiltered database rows. Attackers holding a valid private API key can retrieve bcrypt password hashes, non-expiring hashValidation reset tokens, and TOTP secrets to take over accounts and bypass two-factor authentication.

A vulnerability was identified in Furion .NET Framework up to 4.9.9.92. The impacted element is the function String.Replace of the file framework/Furion/Templates/Extensions/StringRenderExtensions.cs. The manipulation of the argument Name leads to sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A security flaw has been discovered in Furion .NET Framework up to 4.9.9.95. This affects the function RunCompile of the file framework/Furion/ViewEngine/Engines/ViewEngine.cs of the component View Engine. The manipulation of the argument content results in improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine. The attack can be executed remotely. JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SystemApiController getUserRoleSetById handler that allows any authenticated user to read other users' role assignments. Low-privileged attackers can supply an arbitrary userId parameter to retrieve assigned role codes and identify administrator accounts without the system:user:queryUserRole permission.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in AiragBaseApiController that allows authenticated users to read other users' AI chat variables via the username parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to /airag/api/getChatVariable with a target appId, username, and variable name to retrieve stored chat memory values from Redis.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP User Manager WP User Manager wp-user-manager allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP User Manager: from n/a through 2.9.22.

Speedtest Tracker through 1.15.0 contains an IP allowlist bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to evade ALLOWED_IPS and Prometheus allowlists by spoofing X-Forwarded-For headers. Because bootstrap/app.php trusts every peer as a proxy, attackers can supply an allowlisted address to read /prometheus metrics and reach protected web and API endpoints.

ngx_cache_purge before 3.0.4 can allow file deletion via a symlink attack in certain situations where nginx and a served application (e.g., WordPress) run under the same user account. The attacker must be able to create a symlink inside the cache path. Version 3.0.4 fixes this for the case of a symlink created at an arbitrary earlier time, but does not resolve an applicable TOCTOU race condition. VeraCrypt 1.26.29 (FUSE-T build) on macOS sometimes allows unintended access to decrypted data. It does not terminate the FUSE-T auxiliary service (go-nfsv4) and its associated VeraCrypt core-service helper processes when a volume is dismounted. After VeraCrypt reports the volume as dismounted, the auxiliary mount continues to serve the decrypted volume image (volume.dmg) over a loopback SMB session, and the leaked processes retain an open handle to the underlying raw device. The WP Comment Cleaner  WordPress plugin before 7.2 does not perform a capability check or validate a nonce on one of its bulk comment-deletion routines, allowing authenticated users with minimal permissions, such as subscribers, to permanently delete all comments on the site.

The Hotel Booking WordPress plugin through 3.8 does not implement CSRF protection on its administrative booking order management, allowing attackers to trick a logged-in administrator into creating, deleting, or modifying arbitrary booking order records via a forged request.

The Hotel Booking WordPress plugin through 3.8 does not verify that a booking record belongs to the user requesting it, allowing any authenticated user such as a Subscriber to read other customers' booking details, including their name, email address, phone number and postal address, by referencing an identifier they do not own.
